rows.en:
Nanase, you'd better apologize to Ranka-chan
properly, okay?
rows.notes: Player to Nanase after Ranka storms off (female version).
Player wolfs down every carrot dish (third choice), spoiling Nanase's plan.

rows.en:
(It's fine. If me getting hurt means
nobody else has to get hurt...)
What's up? You look so serious.

People-watching? That's admirable.
Are you studying for your acting?
N-no, not that. I was watching the ants...

\p-kun, do you
wanna watch with me?
It's in the woods back there.
Right now they're probably carrying food.

When I watch the ants, it makes me think
"I've gotta work hard too..."
They're tiny, but they're really impressive.

Even when I think that, though,
I can never actually get going.
Why not just start with the little things?
...Well, I guess it's about time to head home.

(I'll work hard too, so I don't end up
like the grasshopper!)
Mmm, nah, I think I'll pass.

rows.notes: x11: Ranka here; the player in several other scenes. Neutral.

rows.en: (I'll grab something to eat and go home.)

People-watching?
Ooh~ are you studying for your acting?

\p-chan, do you
wanna watch with me?
Sure, I'll give it a look.
They're tiny, but they're amazing, huh?

(I'll work hard too, so I don't end up
like the grasshopper!)

(Ranka called me up to the roof, but...
what does she want...? Ba-dump, ba-dump.)

R-Ranka, what's up? Calling me out here
all of a sudden...
You said it the other day, right?
That you wanted to try doing a Kira☆.

Huh?
D-did I say something like that?

No, I know.
I can tell...
rows.notes: Ranka answers the player's doubt as if reading it; she insists she can tell he/she wants to.

rows.en:
Yeah, that's right.
So I'm gonna teach you!
rows.notes: 'Un, sou nanda' read as Ranka confirming her own claim (no player line in between).

rows.en: Y-you mean how to do a Kira☆?

Yeah... I'm gonna drill you hard,
until you can make the star come out.
N-no way, I can't do that!?

rows.notes: Waki wo hiraite: open the arm away from the side.

rows.en: No... Feel it all the way to your fingertips!

rows.notes: Ranka, and the player's final successful try.
Player's failed attempts: no star, unlike Ranka's 'Kira☆'.

rows.en:
M-my fingers...
I can't feel my fingers...

Good work.
There's nothing more I can teach you.

rows.notes: x10, player in several scenes; neutral.

rows.en:
The rest is all about feeling. Put your heart
into it, and you'll definitely be able to do it.

uncertain: c03048: 'Un, sou nanda' follows Ranka's own line with no player line between; read as Ranka confirming her claim ('Yeah, that's right.').
c03062: the player's failed 'Kira' (no star in the Japanese) rendered 'Kira!' to contrast with Ranka's 'Kira☆'.
